world-politics.title: Iran war: What is happening on day 37 of US-Israeli attacks?
world-politics.summary: A U.S. Air Force colonel whose F-15E was shot down over Iran has been rescued by Navy SEAL Team 6 in a large-scale operation involving hundreds of special forces. Iran claims it downed additional U.S. aircraft — a C-130 and two Black Hawks — during the rescue mission.

world-politics.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Rescues Officer From Downed Fighter Jet in Iran, Trump Says
world-politics.summary: President Trump announced early Sunday that a missing U.S. Air Force weapons system officer downed in Iran was rescued by special operations forces in one of the most complex missions in U.S. special operations history. The airman evaded Iranian forces for over 24 hours in the mountains before extraction.

world-politics.title: US aviator missing after Iran shot down fighter jet has been rescued
world-politics.summary: A U.S. military member who had been unaccounted for since Iran downed an F-15E Strike Eagle was successfully rescued, Trump confirmed on social media. The pilot, who sustained injuries, took shelter in the mountains of Iran while Iranian forces searched for him with a bounty on his head.

world-politics.title: Iran rejects Trump's 48-hour Hormuz ultimatum; fire erupts at Kuwait oil complex
world-politics.summary: Iran has officially rejected President Trump's 48-hour ultimatum to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with a senior military official calling it 'a helpless, nervous, unbalanced and stupid action.' The closure of the strait, responsible for 20% of global oil and gas transit, continues to send energy prices soaring.

world-politics.title: Regional ceasefire mediation between US and Iran hits dead end
world-politics.summary: Regional ceasefire efforts led by Pakistan, Turkey, and Egypt to broker a deal between the U.S. and Iran have reportedly reached a dead end, with Iran refusing to meet U.S. officials in Islamabad and declaring American demands unacceptable. Qatar has also resisted serving as the key mediator.

world-politics.title: Thousands rally in Iraq against 'senseless' US-Israel war on Iran
world-politics.summary: Thousands of protesters took to the streets in Iraq chanting against the United States and Israel, urging the global community to confront their military actions in the Middle East. The protests reflect growing regional opposition to the six-week-old conflict that began on February 28.

us-politics.title: Trump fires Attorney General Pam Bondi over Epstein files debacle
us-politics.summary: President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi, citing frustration over her management of the Epstein files, her failure to pursue his political opponents, and her overall handling of the Justice Department. Deputy AG Todd Blanche has been named acting attorney general, making Bondi the second Cabinet member fired this term.

us-politics.title: Supreme Court previously struck down IEEPA tariffs; Trump turns to Section 301 for new trade policy
us-politics.summary: Following the Supreme Court's February 2026 ruling that IEEPA does not authorize the president to impose tariffs, the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative has launched new Section 301 investigations targeting structural overcapacity across 16 major economies. New tariffs could take effect as early as mid-2026.

us-politics.title: A year after 'Liberation Day,' Trump sets new drug tariffs and adjusts metals duties
us-politics.summary: One year after announcing sweeping global tariffs, President Trump ordered 100% tariffs on certain branded pharmaceutical imports and overhauled steel, aluminum, and copper duties after the Supreme Court invalidated his IEEPA-based tariff regime. The federal government is now preparing to refund roughly $166 billion in previously collected tariffs.

us-politics.title: IRS tax refund April 2026: Tariff dividend proposals, stimulus rumors fact-checked
us-politics.summary: The IRS reports tax refunds running higher this year while warning about misleading payment claims circulating online. The government is preparing details on refunding roughly $166 billion in tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court, with announcements expected by mid-April.

us-politics.title: Trump asks Congress for $1.5 trillion defense spending boost as Iran war enters week six
us-politics.summary: President Trump has requested Congress approve a $1.5 trillion defense spending package — the largest such request in decades — as the U.S.-Iran war enters its sixth week. More than 13 U.S. service members have been killed since the conflict began, with over 1,900 deaths reported in Iran.

us-politics.title: Operation Epic Fury: White House touts military objectives against Iran
us-politics.summary: The White House released a statement on Operation Epic Fury, calling it a decisive campaign systematically dismantling Iran's ballistic missile arsenal, navy, and proxy networks. President Trump addressed the nation on the operation's progress, vowing to prevent Iran from ever acquiring a nuclear weapon.

dfw-politics.title: Rapper Pooh Shiesty, eight others indicted in Dallas armed robbery and kidnapping case
dfw-politics.summary: Federal prosecutors indicted rapper Pooh Shiesty and eight others for an armed robbery and kidnapping at a Dallas recording studio in January 2026. Authorities say the motive was to force Williams out of his contract with Gucci Mane's New 1017 Records label.

dfw-politics.title: Storms roll through North Texas Saturday ahead of a dry, cooler Easter Sunday
dfw-politics.summary: North Texas woke up Saturday to lightning, thunder, heavy rain, and gusty winds from an overnight cold front, prompting a First Alert Weather Day. Easter Sunday is expected to be dry and cooler with temperatures in the low 70s — good news for outdoor events.

dfw-politics.title: Organizers unveil 2026 FIFA World Cup transportation plan for North Texas
dfw-politics.summary: With 70 days until the FIFA World Cup arrives in North Texas, organizers detailed a multimodal transit strategy coordinating DART, Trinity Metro, TRE, and charter buses to move fans to Dallas Stadium in Arlington. Construction quiet periods and road closures will be enforced during the June-July tournament.

dfw-politics.title: Fort Worth ISD state takeover enters new phase with state-appointed board and superintendent
dfw-politics.summary: The Texas Education Agency named Dr. Peter B. Licata as Fort Worth ISD's new superintendent and appointed a nine-member Board of Managers to replace the elected school board following a state takeover announced in October 2025. The district, which has 11 failing campuses, is now under full state control.

dfw-politics.title: Dallas violent crime down 13.4% in 2026, but police still miss response-time targets
dfw-politics.summary: Dallas reported a 13.4% drop in violent crime in 2026, a significant improvement attributed to expanded law enforcement initiatives including Project Safe Neighborhoods. However, police departments continue to miss Priority 1 emergency call response-time targets in most divisions.

dfw-politics.title: Major violent crime crackdown expands across North Texas with Project Safe Neighborhoods
dfw-politics.summary: Federal, state, and local law enforcement are ramping up Project Safe Neighborhoods across Fort Worth, Northwest and Northeast Dallas, Amarillo, and Lubbock, targeting repeat offenders, drug trafficking, and illegal weapons. The expansion follows a deadly shooting at Fort Worth's historic Stop 6 Park.

ai-news.title: OpenAI confirms $852 billion valuation and unveils ChatGPT super app strategy
ai-news.summary: OpenAI secured a $122 billion funding round valuing the company at $852 billion and launched a ChatGPT super app combining chat, coding, search, and agent capabilities into a single unified interface. With 900 million weekly users, the company is doubling down on enterprise tools and infrastructure.

ai-news.title: Anthropic releases Claude Mythos 5, world's first 10-trillion-parameter AI model
ai-news.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude Mythos 5, the first widely recognized 10-trillion-parameter AI model, engineered for high-stakes environments including cybersecurity, academic research, and complex coding. Simultaneously, SpaceX acquired xAI for $250 billion, creating a $1.25 trillion AI powerhouse with Starlink distribution.

ai-news.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 with native computer-use and OS-level agentic capabilities
ai-news.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.4 introduces native computer-use capabilities, allowing the model to navigate files, browsers, and terminal interfaces autonomously — surpassing human performance on OS-level benchmarks. The model scored 75% on OSWorld-Verified, a 27.7 percentage point improvement over GPT-5.2.

ai-news.title: Google launches Gemma 4, its most capable open-weight AI models to date
ai-news.summary: Google released Gemma 4 under the Apache 2.0 license, with models spanning edge devices to data centers, supporting advanced reasoning, multimodal capabilities, and over 140 languages. The 26B Mixture-of-Experts model runs on a single 80GB H100 GPU, making frontier AI accessible on-premise.

ai-news.title: Microsoft expands Copilot with multi-model workflows and launches Cowork agent
ai-news.summary: Microsoft upgraded its Copilot platform to allow multiple AI models — including OpenAI's GPT and Anthropic's Claude — to collaborate within a single workflow, with a new Critique feature having one model review another's outputs. The company also expanded Copilot Cowork, an agentic tool that automates multi-step tasks across Office 365.

ai-news.title: MIT study: AI reshaping tasks gradually rather than causing mass job loss
ai-news.summary: An MIT CSAIL study of 11,500 tasks found AI can currently complete about 65% of text-based work at a minimally acceptable level, potentially reaching 95% by 2029. However, reliability limitations and the continued need for human oversight are slowing widespread adoption in real-world workflows.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Jamie Dimon says American Dream is 'slipping out of reach,' launches $80 billion initiative
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon unveiled the American Dream Initiative, pledging nearly $80 billion in small-business lending over the next decade and committing to grow the bank's small-business clients from 7 million to 10 million. The program spans affordable housing, financial health, career skills, healthcare access, and local institution support.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Chase braces for Q1 2026 earnings on April 14 with EPS expected at $5.42
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Chase is set to report Q1 2026 earnings on April 14, with analysts projecting EPS of $5.32–$5.50 and annual net interest income of approximately $95 billion. The bank is positioned as a primary beneficiary of stabilized interest rates at 3.5–3.75% and a 17% surge in Markets revenue.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Chase asserts market dominance amid global energy crisis driven by Iran war
jpmorgan-chase.summary: Trading at ~$294, JPMorgan has shown 'fortress' resilience as competitors reeled from a 12.4% first-quarter downturn, leveraging its diversified revenue streams and pivot to Physical AI infrastructure. The Strait of Hormuz closure pushing Brent crude past $100/barrel poses the bank's key inflation headwind for 2026.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan to host Q1 2026 earnings call April 14 at 8:30 a.m. ET
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Chase announced it will host its first-quarter 2026 earnings call on April 14 at 8:30 a.m. ET, with results scheduled for release at 7:00 a.m. ET. The firm held $4.4 trillion in assets and $362 billion in stockholders' equity as of December 31, 2025.

jpmorgan-chase.title: J.P. Morgan Global Research: US effective tariff rate now at 15.8% after IEEPA ruling
jpmorgan-chase.summary: J.P. Morgan Global Research updated its U.S. tariff rate estimate to 15.8% following the Supreme Court's invalidation of IEEPA tariffs, still elevated from the 2.3% rate at end-2024 but below the prior 18–20% forecast. The bank anticipates pharmaceutical and semiconductor tariffs will push the effective rate higher by mid-to-late 2026.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan predicts 2026 job market dip as Trump-era tariffs and immigration policies weigh on hiring
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan economists forecast sluggish early-2026 job growth stemming from trade policy uncertainty, strict immigration enforcement, and cautious corporate AI investment, with monthly job gains needed to hold unemployment steady dropping to just 15,000. A rebound is expected later in the year as policy clarity improves.

dfw-events.title: Texas Rangers vs. Cincinnati Reds — Easter Sunday at Globe Life Field
dfw-events.summary: The Texas Rangers host the Cincinnati Reds on Easter Sunday, April 5, at 1:35 p.m. at Globe Life Field in Arlington. This is part of the home opener weekend series, with weather expected to clear to the low 70s by game time after Saturday's storms.

dfw-events.title: Deep Ellum Community Arts Fair — Final Day, April 5
dfw-events.summary: The annual Deep Ellum Community Arts Fair wraps up Sunday, April 5, with eight blocks of original art, live performances across four stages, and food from more than 120 artists and 80 bands. The three-day neighborhood festival in Deep Ellum is one of Dallas's signature spring events.

dfw-events.title: Collect A Con at Fort Worth Convention Center — April 5
dfw-events.summary: Collect A Con returns to the Fort Worth Convention Center Arena on Sunday, April 5 at 10:00 a.m., featuring pop culture collectibles, celebrity meet-and-greets, comic books, toys, and memorabilia for fans of all ages. The convention center holds up to 13,500 guests.

dfw-events.title: The SpongeBob Musical at Casa Mañana — Easter Weekend
dfw-events.summary: The SpongeBob Musical runs at Casa Mañana in Fort Worth with an Easter Sunday matinee at 3:00 p.m., offering family-friendly Broadway entertainment for the holiday weekend. Casa Mañana holds 1,805 guests at 3101 W Lancaster Ave, Fort Worth.

dfw-events.title: The Jazz Room: A Tribute to Frank Sinatra & Louis Armstrong — April 5 at Edison's Dallas
dfw-events.summary: The Jazz Room presents a tribute to Frank Sinatra and Louis Armstrong at Edison's (1724 Cockrell Ave, Dallas) on Sunday, April 5, offering an intimate evening of classic jazz in one of Dallas's most atmospheric venues. The show is part of a monthly jazz series running through late April.

dfw-events.title: Flip Circus at North East Mall, Hurst — April 5
dfw-events.summary: Flip Circus brings its high-energy acrobatic spectacular to North East Mall in Hurst on Sunday, April 5 at 1:00 p.m., with death-defying acts, clowns, and family entertainment under the big top. The traveling circus runs multiple shows throughout April across the DFW area.
